description: This source file defines the CommandClientImpl class, a Java implementation of a client for Hono's Command and Control API using Vertx and Proton libraries. It manages sending command messages to devices and handling responses, with methods for creating and managing AMQP links, sending commands, and generating message IDs. The class implements the CommandClient interface and extends AbstractRequestResponseClient, providing mechanisms for asynchronous communication with IoT devices under a specific tenant context.

classes.name: CommandClientImpl
classes.description: A Vertx-Proton based client implementation for Hono's Command & Control API, enabling sending commands and handling responses over AMQP links.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target address for sending commands to a specific device within a tenant.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the endpoint name used for command requests.

methods.name: getReplyToEndpointName
methods.description: Returns the endpoint name used for receiving command responses.

methods.name: createMessageId
methods.description: Generates a short, unique message ID based on an internal counter for correlating requests and responses.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Constructs a BufferResult object encapsulating response details.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to a device with optional content type and properties, returning a Future with the response BufferResult.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommand
methods.description: Sends a command without expecting a response (fire-and-forget), returns a Future<Void>.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of CommandClient scoped to a specific tenant and device, initiating link creation and connection setup.
